function: Joint DRL control of UAV trajectory, STAR-RIS coefficients and UAV transmit and receive beamforming, maximizing admitted sensing targets under user and target SINR constraints (p. 1, 3).
system: Rotary-wing UAV, full-duplex, ULA of Mu=8 antennas, serves K=4 users and L=4 sensing targets (single antenna) via a STAR-RIS with Mr=16 elements; carrier frequency not stated (p. 2, 5).
method: Recurrent DDPG (RDPG) reinforcement-learning agent, a recurrent actor-critic, plus meta-learning (meta-critic, bi-level optimization) for adaptation; centralized at the UAV; no federated learning (p. 4-5).
data_channel: Own simulator: distance-based line-of-sight array-response channels UAV-user, UAV-STAR-RIS and STAR-RIS-user with reference gain beta0 (from [13]); agent trains by interaction, no dataset, 3GPP or measured data (p. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Training and test conditions not stated; results sweep target SINR, flight range, power and STAR-RIS size; meta-learning adaptation is claimed but not tested on unseen settings (p. 3, 5).
baselines: Learned: conventional RDPG (no meta-learning), SAC of [6]. Non-learned: greedy resource allocation; system without STAR-RIS also compared (p. 5).
metrics: Number of admitted sensing targets (admission rate) versus target SINR, UAV power budget and STAR-RIS size; average episodic reward versus training episodes (p. 5).
q1_support: p. 2: "We denote the channel between the UAV and" each receiver by a distance-based line-of-sight array response with reference gain beta0 [13]; custom simulator, and no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 3: "imposes a mismatch between the training and testing stage" is the motivation for meta-learning, but no test in conditions unseen in training is described; Fig. 3(b)-(d) (p. 5) are sweeps of target SINR, flight range, power and STAR-RIS size.
q3_support: p. 5: "greedy resource allocation scheme" (non-learned) and "compared to the soft-actor critic (SAC) scheme [6]" (earlier learned method), on reward and admission rate; RDPG without meta-learning is only an ablation.
q4_support: p. 5: "slightly increased computational overhead and memory" is a qualitative statement; no FLOPs, parameter count or runtime of the proposed method is reported.
q5_support: p. 5: "Simulation parameters include" its own settings (Mr, Mu, T, N, K, L, Pmax); no link, DOI or public dataset, and the agent trains by interaction with its own simulated environment (p. 4).
notes: Area 6: UAV (aerial) ISAC link where the learned agent controls beams and STAR-RIS coefficients jointly with the trajectory, so the order rule gives 6 over 5 and 3; reviewer to confirm. It passes above_phy because the trajectory is learned jointly with beamforming and STAR-RIS coefficients (p. 1). q3: greedy appears only in the reward-versus-episodes plot (Fig. 3(a)) and is not described; SAC [6] is compared on admission rate (p. 5). q2: meta-learning is claimed (p. 4-5) but not evaluated on unseen conditions.
